domains.title: Domains
domains.description: One domain per line, e.g. github.com. No http:// needed. You can add several.

checkLiveCert.title: Check the live certificate
checkLiveCert.description: For each subdomain, connect over HTTPS and read its current SSL certificate (issuer, expiry, days left, whether it is valid right now). Turn off for a faster, records-only run.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on subdomains returned per run. Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free.
